name: Firebase
summary: Google's hosted Firestore database and Firebase Authentication, protected with Firestore security rules.
bestFor: Teams already on Google Cloud, or sites that also have a mobile app.
cost: Free Spark plan for small sites; pay as you go on Blaze.
tested: Tested 21 October 2026 in the Firebase emulators: 63 security-rule checks across every role, plus the sign-in and bookings screens end to end. Server-side session cookies aren't covered by the test yet.
